notes: Excluded 240 scheduled 2026 nflverse games that have not been played yet (no final score as of the download).

Sign check: in 98.4% of 5,322 nflverse games with both a non-zero spread and a moneyline, the spread favorite is also the moneyline favorite; the rest are near pick'em games where the two quotes disagree. Both values are kept as published.
Player-game rows whose game_id is not in the games panel: 0 (of 150,669); kept with blank date/home_away.
Games 1990-1998 come from the spreadspoke (Kaggle) archive; games 1999-2026 come from nflverse. Both include regular season and playoffs.

Point spreads and totals: spreadspoke 1990-1998 (stored favorite-relative, converted to the home team's handicap), nflverse 1999+ (spread_line is home-favored-positive; the panel stores the negative so a favored team has a negative line). These are the sources' pre-game reference lines, not verified closing lines.
Line coverage: 100.0% of team-games have a spread, 100.0% have a total.
Moneylines only exist in nflverse from 2006; seasons before that have a blank moneyline and blank implied_win. Moneyline coverage 2006+: 97.5% of team-games.

Franchise codes follow the current franchise: Houston/Tennessee Oilers -> TEN, Los Angeles/Oakland Raiders -> LV, Los Angeles/St. Louis Rams -> LA, San Diego Chargers -> LAC, Phoenix Cardinals -> ARI, Washington (all names) -> WAS. The 1990-1995 Cleveland Browns are CLE (the NFL assigns that history to Cleveland); the Baltimore Ravens (BAL) start in 1996.
decided_in (OT vs REG) is only known for 1999+ (nflverse overtime flag); it is blank for 1990-1998.
Neutral-site games (Super Bowls, international games) have home_away = N for both teams.

Player-game stats start in 1999 (nflverse); there is no free per-game player data for 1990-1998. Only QB/RB/WR/TE rows are kept. data/nfl_players.csv holds per-game rows for 2024-2026; data/nfl_player_seasons.csv holds season totals for 1999-2026 (one row per player, season, team and game type, so regular season and playoffs are separate).
1990-91 to 2000-01: 12,995 games from FiveThirtyEight (11 at neutral sites such as Tokyo/Mexico City). This source has no overtime flag, so decided_in is blank for these seasons.
2001-02 onward (ESPN via hoopR): 33,496 schedule rows; dropped 39 all-star/exhibition or TBD rows, 0 preseason rows, 1,267 unplayed or postponed rows (including the unplayed 2026-27 schedule).
3 NBA Cup / In-Season Tournament championship games are kept as regular-season rows (real games between NBA teams, although the league excludes them from standings).
The 172 games of the 2020 Orlando bubble (30 Jul - 11 Oct 2020) are coded home_away=N (neutral site); ESPN keeps a nominal home team but no team played at home.

Play-in games (season_type 5) are coded game_type=playoff. decided_in comes from ESPN's final period (4 = regulation, 5+ = overtime); 385 games have no usable period value (mostly 2001-02) and are blank.
Score cross-check vs ESPN team box scores: 32,176 games compared, 0 home-score mismatches.

Betting lines: SportsbookReviewsOnline closing spread/total/moneyline for 2007-08 to 2021-22; hoopR consensus closing spread/total (The Odds API, ~9 books) for 2022-23 onward, which has no moneylines; hoopR games-archive.json fills a few remaining 2017-18 to 2022-23 gaps. No free lines exist before 2007-08, so line/total_line/moneyline are blank for 1990-91 to 2006-07.
Lines by source (games): SBRO 19,140, odds-api 5,281, games-archive 5.

Team codes are current franchise abbreviations; relocated franchises are mapped to today's team: Seattle SuperSonics -> OKC, Vancouver Grizzlies -> MEM, New Jersey Nets -> BKN, Washington Bullets -> WAS, Charlotte Hornets 1990-2002 and Bobcats 2004-14 -> CHA, New Orleans (and Oklahoma City) Hornets 2002-13 -> NOP (the NBA's official franchise lineage).

Player box scores (ESPN via hoopR) start in 2001-02; no free bulk player-game source was found for 1990-91 to 2000-01. Dropped 179,789 did-not-play rows (no minutes) and 454 rows from games outside the panel (all-star, preseason, exhibitions).
data/nba_players.csv holds per-game lines for 2024-25 onward (56,957 rows); data/nba_player_seasons.csv holds season totals per player, team and game type for 2001-02 onward (19,458 rows).
The information used here was obtained free of charge from and is copyrighted by Retrosheet. Interested parties may contact Retrosheet at www.retrosheet.org.

Team codes are current franchise codes: Montreal Expos (MON) -> WSH, Florida Marlins (FLO) -> MIA, California/Anaheim Angels (CAL/ANA) -> LAA, Tampa Bay Devil Rays -> TB, Oakland Athletics (OAK) -> ATH, Cleveland Indians -> CLE.
Retrosheet 1990–2025: 83,228 regular-season and 1,167 postseason games. All-Star games excluded.
2026 games come from the MLB Stats API (final/official games through the download date; last game 2026-09-23). Retrosheet does not yet cover 2026.

103 games flagged neutral site (home_away = N): the listed home team played fewer than 5 games at that park that season (international series, Field of Dreams, Little League Classic, relocated makeup games). Temporary home parks with 5+ games (Expos in San Juan 2003-04, Blue Jays in Buffalo/Dunedin 2020-21) count as home games.

Odds (closing moneyline, closing total; run line 2014+) from SportsbookReviewsOnline season files 2010–2021, matched on date + teams + final score. No free odds archive covers 1990–2009 or 2022–2026, so those seasons have blank odds columns. Match rate by season: 2010: 2,456/2,462 games (99.8%), 2 ambiguous left blank; 2011: 2,462/2,467 games (99.8%), 2 ambiguous left blank; 2012: 2,467/2,467 games (100.0%); 2013: 2,464/2,469 games (99.8%); 2014: 2,455/2,462 games (99.7%); 2015: 2,461/2,465 games (99.8%); 2016: 2,453/2,463 games (99.6%), 3 ambiguous left blank; 2017: 2,464/2,468 games (99.8%); 2018: 2,460/2,464 games (99.8%); 2019: 2,460/2,466 games (99.8%); 2020: 948/951 games (99.7%); 2021: 2,457/2,466 games (99.6%).
MLB `line` is the run line (±1.5). Run line favorite = the team laying 1.5 runs.
Player ids are Retrosheet ids; 2026 Stats API players are mapped via the Chadwick register (6,173 of 68,348 2026 player-game rows unmapped, kept with id 'mlbam<id>').

Player-game file covers 2024–2026 (regular season + postseason; batter and pitcher rows separate). Player-season file covers 1990–2026, regular season only, one row per player/team/role (a traded player has one row per team).

NHL Stats API lists 48,359 games since 1990-91; dropped 3,708 preseason, all-star and other exhibition games and 1,461 regular/playoff games not yet played (the 2026-27 schedule and unneeded 'if necessary' playoff games).

Odds: SportsbookReviewsOnline closing moneyline and closing total, 2007-08 to 2021-22 plus the part of 2022-23 the Internet Archive kept; puck line (+/-1.5) from 2014-15. No free odds source was found for later seasons, so line fields are blank there. 0 odds rows with ambiguous duplicate keys and 7 matches whose SBR final score disagreed with the NHL score were left without odds.

Scores are exactly as the NHL publishes them: a shootout win is recorded as a one-goal win (the shootout winner is credited one goal). decided_in = REG, OT, or SO (shootouts began 2005-06). Regular-season games tied after overtime (1990-91 to 2003-04) have result T.

Teams use the NHL's own franchise ids mapped to each franchise's current code: Quebec -> COL, Hartford -> CAR, Minnesota North Stars -> DAL, Atlanta Thrashers -> WPG, original Winnipeg Jets and Phoenix -> ARI. The NHL treats Utah (UTA, 2024-25 on) as a new franchise, so ARI and UTA are separate teams.
Goalie game logs: 93,282 goalie appearances from the NHL Stats API (0 duplicate or non-panel rows removed); 43,190 of 43,190 games have exactly two recorded starting goalies.
Player files: per-game skater lines for 2024-25 to 2025-26 (feeds projections); regular-season player totals for 1990-91 to 2025-26. Goalie save % = saves / shots against.
Matches per season: 462 in 1993-94 and 1994-95 (22 clubs), 380 from 1995-96 to 2025-26 (20 clubs); 2026-27 is in progress with 50 matches played by the download date.
All Premier League matches are regular-season (no playoffs) and played at the home club's ground; team codes are football-data.co.uk club names, which are stable across seasons (no relocations).

1X2 odds source by season: 1993-94 to 1999-00: none; 2000-01: single bookmaker WH pre-match (WH); 2001-02: single bookmaker IW pre-match (IW); 2002-03 to 2004-05: Bet365 pre-match (B365); 2005-06 to 2018-19: pre-match market average (BbAv); 2019-20 to 2026-27: closing market average (AvgC)
Only 2019-20 onward uses true closing odds (market average at kick-off); earlier seasons are pre-match snapshots, and 1993-94 to 1999-00 have no odds at all.
2001-02: 1X2 odds present for 378 of 380 matches (rest left blank).

Asian handicap line (the `line` column, home handicap, negative = favored) by season: 1993-94 to 2004-05: none; 2005-06 to 2018-19: pre-match Asian handicap (BbAHh); 2019-20 to 2026-27: closing Asian handicap (AHCh)

`total_line` is set to 2.5 goals only where the file carries over/under-2.5 odds for the match (so `ou_result` is over/under 2.5 goals); blank otherwise. O/U odds column by season: 1993-94 to 2001-02: none; 2002-03 to 2004-05: B365>2.5; 2005-06 to 2018-19: BbAv>2.5; 2019-20 to 2026-27: AvgC>2.5
2013-14: Asian handicap line present for 370 of 380 matches (rest left blank).
2002-03: over/under-2.5 odds present for 251 of 380 matches.
2003-04: over/under-2.5 odds present for 378 of 380 matches.
2004-05: over/under-2.5 odds present for 375 of 380 matches.
Sanity check: market favorites won 54.2% and drew 24.8% of 9,866 team-games with odds.
Asian handicap quarter lines (e.g. -0.75) split the stake across two lines; `line_result` here is simply margin + line compared with zero, so a quarter-line half-win counts as cover.
